children.innerHTML: A crew of licensed trades who show up in the window they promised, fix it once, and leave the place cleaner than they found it. Radical stuff.

Every job
a house throws at you
Six trades under one number. One invoice, one guarantee, no finger-pointing between subbies.
Leaks found, taps re-seated, bathrooms replumbed. Water where it should be, nowhere it shouldn't.
Rewires, fuse boards, EV chargers. Certified, tested, and labelled so the next person isn't guessing.
Boilers serviced and swapped, radiators balanced, smart controls that actually obey you.
A human answers at 3 a.m. A van arrives before the kettle's cold. Stopcocks are found.
Kitchens and bathrooms from first-fix to the last bead of silicone, one crew start to finish.
A yearly once-over that catches the small stuff while it's still small. Landlords love us.
“They quoted a number, charged that number, and my boiler has been boring ever since. Boring is the dream.”
Photo, video, interpretive hum of the noise it's making. All accepted.
A fixed price before anyone lifts a tool. If we find worse, we stop and talk.
Right part, first visit, dust sheets down. Most jobs close same-day.
Twelve months in writing. If it misbehaves, the return visit is on us.
Tell us today, it's fixed this week. Usually tomorrow.
Burst pipe? No power? The 24/7 line: 0800 4 RIVET
